key_rationale: With headline CPI at 3.54% and core inflation at 3.15%, the real repo rate has become excessively restrictive, threatening to stifle the growth momentum indicated by the 6.80% GVA growth. Maintaining a 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance is no longer appropriate when inflation is comfortably within the target band, and a 25 bps cut is necessary to align the policy rate with the evolving macroeconomic reality.
